snippet.title: FAIRY TAIL: Fierce Fight SEA Trailer
snippet.description:
FAIRY TAIL: Fierce Fight SEA is an upcoming mobile action RPG launching soon for Android and iOS devices! Based on the popular manga/anime by Hiro Mashima, the game is officially licensed by Kodansha!

More info here: https://www.enduins.com/mobile-games/fairy-tail-fierce-fight-sea-mobile-arpg-begins-pre-registration/
